answer:
Therapies associated with Vipadika

The available records associate Vipadika with the following therapies:

1. Oral Medication [1]
2. Sarvanga Abhyanga [2]
3. Snehapana [3]
4. Swedana [4]
5. Udvartana [5]
6. Virechana [6]
7. Shamana [7]
